verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Calendar Sync copies events from source calendars onto a destination calendar so that bookings reflect 'true availability across multiple calendars' and time is defended 'across all of your schedules'. It works with Google and Outlook and auto-reschedules when conflicts arise. Apple/iCloud is only supported indirectly, by syncing an iCloud shared calendar into a Google Calendar, and conflict checking depends on sync copies rather than native checking of every connected calendar. Missing for 10: native Apple/iCloud calendar connection, explicit documentation that all connected calendars are checked for double-booking, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-calendar conflict prevention.
